gh pr view JSON fields include baseRefOid and headRefOid.
gh api --input - reads the request body from stdin.
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews accepts commit_id, event, body, and comments.
Each inline comment supplies path, line, side, and body. RIGHT identifies the new file.
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews returns reviews in chronological order with page and per_page pagination.
Review responses include id, state, commit_id, and body. Foreman preserves the first three as its receipt.
Source checked 2026-11-21: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/reviews?apiVersion=2022-11-28#list-reviews-for-a-pull-request
